fusions.name: Hundredth Hammerfall
fusions.desc: A practised hammer blow that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: The Rehearsed Turn
fusions.desc: Swings the hammer through a full turn, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit, and each enemy hit is left [Leaden] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Mailed Footwork
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 20% and your dodge chance by 8% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Rote and Rivet
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 10. The next ability you use spends them all: you gain a shield that soaks 3% of your maximum health per stack (28% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
